answer: Each identity claims one pulse from a distinct mast in the epoch roster; each mast signs only one identity per epoch, and its signature extends the roster's shared vine of prior pulses, so one mast cannot cover two clones. The k-th fake pays a bribe of 20k credits, so N fakes cost 10N(N+1) credits: ten cost 1,100, a hundred cost 101,000. A mirror replay of the roster log at close burns every forged pulse.
